tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation strongly rejects the attempted siphon law. A fine trajectory batch supplies the minimum additional data needed to test and fit the documented coupled-memory ODE, rather than prematurely abstaining or committing to another untested model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It has four fitted parameters and the archive specifies at least eight rows; the current seven do not meet that threshold.
The fitted siphon model missed fresh confirmation badly (RMSE 0.67664 vs 0.045 tolerance), so simply retuning its branch is not well supported.
Fresh confirmation refuted the siphon model, but has not refuted all documented stationary mechanisms; an informative trajectory batch remains available.
